jobs.title: CXG Data Specialist
jobs.description:
RemoFirst is transforming the way businesses hire and manage global teams. Our mission is to enable Freedom of Work by providing an all-in-one global HR platform that simplifies hiring, compliance, payroll, and benefits management. We partner with some of the world’s most innovative companies, including Fortune 500 businesses and leading startups.

We are a small but strong team of 200+ people (and growing) hyper-focused on delivering a world-class platform and unparalleled service with our industry-leading partnerships. 

We are seeking a CXG Data Specialist to support and optimize our data quality across the full CXG tech stack. Reporting at the intersection of Customer Success, Revenue Operations and Sales, you will play a key role in maintaining the data accuracy of our CXG systems.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused on execution, continuous improvement, and providing exceptional operational support to our CXG team in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own proactive data quality monitoring and clean-up across CXG systems.

jobs.title: Global Legal Associate: Fintech&Compliance
jobs.description:
RemoFirst is transforming the way businesses hire and manage global teams. Our mission is to enable Freedom of Work by providing an all-in-one global HR platform that simplifies hiring, compliance, payroll, and benefits management. We partner with some of the world’s most innovative companies, including Fortune 500 businesses and leading startups.

 

We are a small but strong team of 200+ people (and growing) hyper-focused on delivering a world-class platform and unparalleled service with our industry-leading partnerships.

 As Global Legal Associate, Fintech & Compliance, you'll be the legal partner to our Product, Engineering and Finance teams on everything that moves money: payroll funding, contractor payouts, cross-border payments, deposits and FX. You'll get involved early, turn regulation into clear product requirements and help us launch quickly without creating regulatory risk. You'll also help run the fintech compliance programme that keeps those products sound once they're live.

What you'll do

Our mission is to enable Freedom of Work by providing an all-in-one global HR platform that simplifies hiring, compliance, payroll, and benefits management. We’re hiring a Product Operations Manager to drive clarity, speed, and excellence across our product organization. You’ll act as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and cross-functional teams (Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Compliance, Legal).
